transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm sorry to take up your time, but I just can't shake this feeling that I'm a terrible person and that everything that's gone wrong is my fault. It really feels like I've already messed up my whole life, and I don't know what to do anymore.
Have you felt this way for most days over the last two years, or are these feelings relatively new to you?

It hasn't been a full two years, but it's been going on for a little over a year now, about fourteen months. It really started when I began pushing myself so hard to finish my GED while taking on all those extra work shifts. I've felt this heavy almost every single day since then.
During your life, have there been any other periods in the past where you felt this way for several weeks or months, or is this the first time you have ever experienced these symptoms?

No, this is the very first time I've ever felt like this. Before I started pushing myself so hard with my GED and extra shifts about fourteen months ago, I never felt this heavy or heard any of those voices. I was always able to keep up with my life before all of this.

Since this started fourteen months ago, have you had any periods where you felt completely back to your normal self for a few weeks or months, or has the sadness been constant throughout this entire time?

No, it's been constant and I haven't had any weeks or months where I felt like my old self again. At most, there are just rare, brief days where the heavy cloud lifts slightly and the voices quiet down a bit. But the sadness and the struggle have been there pretty much every single day.
You mentioned hearing voices; are these voices commenting on your actions or criticizing you, and do they occur only when you are feeling extremely sad?

Yes, especially late at night when I'm alone, I hear this man's voice right behind my left ear telling me I'm worthless, that I've disappointed God, and that something bad will happen to my family. It only happens when I'm feeling this deeply depressed; before this dark period started, I never heard anything like that, and the voice quiets down on the rare days my mood lifts a bit.
Besides the voices, have you ever felt that your thoughts were being controlled by an outside force, or that people were trying to harm you because of these beliefs?
No, I've never felt like my thoughts were being controlled by some outside force. And I don't think anyone is trying to physically hurt me, either.
To clarify, have you ever experienced a similar episode of deep depression, with or without these voices, at any point in your life prior to this fourteen-month period?

No, never. This is the absolute first time I've ever felt this way or gone through anything like this. Before those fourteen months when I started pushing myself so hard with work and my GED, I was doing okay.
Since this started fourteen months ago, have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep, appetite, or energy levels compared to how you were before?

My sleep has been terrible because I lie awake for hours with my mind racing, only to wake up at three or four in the morning with my heart pounding. I drag myself through the day completely exhausted and feeling like my body is in slow motion, though my appetite hasn't really changed much. The lack of sleep and energy is just constant and makes everything so hard.
When you hear these voices, do you feel like they are completely real and external sounds, or do you have any sense that they might be coming from your own mind?

They feel completely real and external, like a man is standing right behind my left ear speaking to me, even though I know no one is physically in the room. In that moment, it is absolutely terrifying because it sounds just like a real person is there. It doesn't feel like it's coming from my own mind at all when it's happening.
